description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan charge functionalities with specific due dates in the Apache Fineract project. It tests applying fees and penalties, waiving charges, and handling disbursements with respect to overdue loans, including accruals and full repayments.

classes.name: LoanChargeSpecificDueDateTest
classes.description: A set of integration tests for verifying application and handling of loan charges, penalties, waivers, accruals, and disbursements with specific due dates in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configurations, request and response specifications, and helper class instances before each test.

methods.name: testApplyLoanSpecificDueDateFeeWithDisbursementDate
methods.description: Tests applying a specific due date fee to a loan disbursed on a given date, including accruals and full repayment.

methods.name: testApplyLoanSpecificDueDatePenaltyWithDisbursementDate
methods.description: Tests applying a penalty with a specific due date, with disbursement occurring on a specified date, verifying accruals and repayment.

methods.name: testApplyAndWaiveInstallmentFee
methods.description: Tests applying an installment fee, waiving it, and verifying the resulting loan status and transactions.

methods.name: testApplyAndWaiveInstallmentFeeAnotherDueDate
methods.description: Verifies applying, waiving, and the effect of an installment fee on a later due date after a disbursement.

methods.name: testApplyAndWaiveLoanSpecificDueDatePenaltyWithDisbursementDate
methods.description: Similar to above tests but for penalties with disbursement on a specified date.

methods.name: testApplyFeeAccrualOnClosedDate
methods.description: Tests applying charges and accruals on a loan, including partial and full repayments, and validating journal entries.

methods.name: testApplyLoanSpecificDueDatePenaltyWithDisbursementDateWithMultipleDisbursement
methods.description: Checks handling of multiple disbursements and charges applying on each disbursed installment.

methods.name: testApplyLoanSpecificDueDatePenaltyAccrualWithDisbursementDateWithMultipleDisbursement
methods.description: Tests accruals and charges with multiple disbursements spread over time.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper to create a loan product with specific parameters for testing.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithPeriodicAccrual
methods.description: Creates a loan product with periodic accrual accounting enabled.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper to create and approve a loan account for a client.

methods.name: validateLoanAccount
methods.description: Validates the outstanding balances, penalties, and total due for a loan account in tests.
